sources.title: add --discussion-category flag to release cmd
sources.body: Flag for signaling that a discussion should be created with the given category for the release. Discussions are not supported for draft releases. If a discussion category is given for a draft, an error will be shown. Closes #3381.
sources.author: despreston

sources.title: Creating discussions for a release using the CLI
sources.body: Request to create a linked discussion from gh release create, with an example using a discussion category.
sources.author: panva
